$comment: Machine-readable migration registry. The SessionStart hook reads it to decide whether a project's `configuredWith` marker sits below a version that introduced a REQUIRED migration. Written when a version is published — never inferred from the changelog prose. `required: true` means the project behaves differently, or stops working as documented, unless the developer acts; everything additive and opt-in is `required: false` and MUST NOT notify. Adding entries is the only supported way to make the startup notice fire.

migrations.title: Operating modes per repo (crew.json)
migrations.summary: A repo without crew.json keeps behaving exactly as before; adopting modes, metrics and the quality gate is opt-in.

migrations.title: Design capabilities, design memory and the configuration marker
migrations.summary: Additive: undeclared capabilities are simply unavailable and the roles say so. Running /crew:setup is optional and always asks before writing.

migrations.title: Estimation totals and the verification table
migrations.summary: Closing a work item now requires a Total row in the estimation table wherever that gate already ran — one line per item. The verification table binds only where crew.json declares `testing`.

migrations.title: bin/ renamed to scripts/
migrations.summary: A pre-commit hook installed before 0.24 still points at bin/check-quality.sh and no longer resolves — the quality gate stops running silently. Re-run scripts/init-project.sh, which rewrites the path in place.

migrations.title: Work-item standard at every write
migrations.summary: Additive: the shape guard denies only under team + quality enforce; everything else is a notice. Deviations from the crew template are declared in the crew:standard block of docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

migrations.title: Security triggers, hook bypass and policy relaxations
migrations.summary: No action required. In projects with crew.json, agents can no longer run --no-verify or set core.hooksPath, and relaxing crew.json or host settings under team + enforce needs a crew:policy entry in docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

migrations.title: Findings shape, receipts and sized ceremony
migrations.summary: Additive and opt-in. Note: /crew:metrics doubled estimated and actual hours since 0.23 by counting the Total row; regenerate any exported metrics.csv.

migrations.title: Doctor, brownfield adoption and configuration security scan
migrations.summary: Additive. Projects scaffolded earlier have no install record; the doctor works without it. A one-line security notice appears at session start in crew projects until a scan is filed.
